input.quote: subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges
input.rationale: No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment language appears in the body of the Agreement; fees are payable per the Fee Schedule and maintenance runs in one-year terms that we can exit under Section 17(b). We should confirm Schedule "A" contains no multi-year committed spend, as the Schedules are not attached to the draft reviewed.

input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 imposes exit obligations only on us; there is no transition-assistance right and no obligation on Garman to return our data in a usable format or to certify deletion (the escrow licence in Section 16(b) only helps on Garman default). We inserted six months of paid transition assistance, data return in machine-readable form within 30 days and certified deletion; 90 days of assistance is our fallback.
